about: Virginia localities for the Footing Fit Score. Every field cites SOURCES. null = we could not get it (the reason is next to it). A missing local rule means 'not checked yet', never 'no rule'.

camping_law.note: No statewide camping ban. HB1394 (2026), which would have stopped cities from punishing people for sleeping in public, was continued to 2027.

fbi_cde_second.title: Crime Data Explorer, agency summaries - second independent capture
fbi_cde_second.note: Captured separately from fbi_cde on the same day. Used to cross-check the offence counts (they agree for all 240 shared agencies) and for months reported, where it is the more precise of the two. See docs/FACT_CHECK.md.

city_incidents.title: Police incident reports, 12 months, geocoded to ~1 km tiles (Norfolk and Charlottesville)
city_incidents.publisher: City of Norfolk and City of Charlottesville open data; U.S. Census batch geocoder
city_incidents.note: Counts per tile only. No address, incident ID or officer name was kept. Trespass, loitering, drunkenness and similar calls are bucketed as 'enforcement' and are never counted as danger: they show where police make contact, which is where unhoused people already are. Capture method: data_raw/city_incidents_MANIFEST.json.
